requirement.en: When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster, shuffle 1 Cyberse Type monster and 1 non-Cyberse Type monster from your Graveyard into the Deck.

effect.en: Choose 1 face-up Level 8 or lower monster on your opponent's field, and change it to face-down Defense Position. Then, if you have a face-up EARTH Attribute Cyberse Type Ritual Monster on your field, you can destroy the chosen monster.
